newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Jan-June home aluminium sales up 13.3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Jan-June home aluminium sales up 13.3 pct.

text.p: Brazilian internal sales of all primary aluminium reached 104,800 tonnes in the first half of this year, up 13.3 percent on the 92,500 tonnes sold in Janaury to June 1996, said the Brazilian Aluminium Association.
Sales in June reached 17,700 tonnes, up 12 percent from 15,800 tonnes in June last year and 5.4 percent higher than the 16,800 tonnes sold in May 1997.
Forecasts for total 1997 sales are around 210,000 tonnes which would be a growth of 6.9 percent on the 196,500 tonnes sold in 1996, the association said.
